FN-L5695YA-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 354
Committee: Ways and Means General Fund Sponsor: Representative Jim Hill
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: «Released Date»
House Bill 354 as introduced proposes a constitutional amendment, which if ratified, would
allow the compensation paid to district attorneys to be increased during his or her term.
Additionally, this bill will increase the proclamation expenses of the Governor, paid from the
State General Fund, by an estimated $100,000 for the fiscal year ending September 30, 2026.
Page 1
